description: How LIR operators, routing engineers, policy participants, and measurement analysts relate to each other: who operates resources for whom, how measurement evidence circulates, and how community policy frames registry operations.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Mandates and service arrangements around number resources

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day operation of registry state, routing, RPKI, and reverse DNS

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Measurement evidence, incident analysis, and policy feedback

relations.name: Mandates routing and RPKI operations
relations.description: Gives its routing and peering engineers the mandate to operate the organisation's number resources: announcing prefixes, maintaining ROAs, and running reverse DNS against the registry's state.

relations.name: Keeps registry and routing state aligned
relations.description: Flags stale registry objects, mismatched ROAs, and incorrect reverse DNS delegations found during filtering and incident diagnosis so the LIR corrects its registrations before they cause reachability damage.

relations.name: Brings operational evidence into policy
relations.description: Raises address scarcity, transfer friction, and registry workflow pain into working groups and policy proposals as the operator evidence behind policy change.

relations.name: Sets the resource policy frame
relations.description: Produces consensus policy on allocation, transfers, and registration accuracy that defines the rules LIRs operate under when requesting, holding, and transferring resources.

relations.name: Promotes routing security norms
relations.description: Turns community consensus on RPKI adoption, route-object hygiene, and filtering best practice into the norms engineers implement in their networks.

relations.name: Hosts measurement vantage points
relations.description: Hosts Atlas probes and anchors and peers with route collectors, supplying the raw vantage points that researchers and analysts depend on for global measurement coverage.

relations.name: Publishes routing incident analysis
relations.description: Publishes hijack, leak, and outage analyses built on RIS and Atlas data that engineers use to tune filters, verify ROA coverage, and diagnose their own incidents faster.

relations.name: Grounds policy debates in measurement
relations.description: Feeds country reports, dataset analyses, and adoption statistics into governance discussions so policy positions rest on measured reality rather than anecdote.
